issues.problem: tai-ga-o contrast for の said 車の欲しい is simply wrong, but inside a noun-modifying clause の can replace が (車の欲しい人 is correct), so the note teaches a falsehood.
issues.action: Rewrote the note: の cannot mark the wanted thing at the end of a sentence (車の欲しいです is wrong); only in a clause that describes a noun can it replace が (車の欲しい人).
